verdict.rationale: Qodo's Agentic Toolbox explicitly documents an MCP server that lets coding agents 'retrieve and resolve review findings' and a CLI to 'review changes before opening a pull request,' plus a direct in-platform 'let Qodo apply the fix directly' option — all supporting agent handoff of review findings. However, the docs don't explicitly name Claude Code/Cursor/Codex as supported clients (relying on generic MCP compatibility) nor describe a 'copyable fix prompt' format, and there's no independent/community confirmation this handoff works smoothly in practice. Missing for 10: explicit named integrations with Claude Code/Cursor/Codex, evidence of copyable prompt format, independent hands-on corroboration of the agent handoff flow.
